import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def init(maxVal, mod):
    inv = [1]*(maxVal+1)
    p = [1]*(maxVal+1)
    for i in range(2, maxVal+1):
        inv[i] = (mod - mod//i) * inv[mod % i] % mod
        p[i] = p[i-1] * i % mod
    for i in range(2, maxVal+1):
        inv[i] = inv[i-1] * inv[i] % mod
    return inv, p

def power(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = res * base % mod
        base = base * base % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def main():
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    mod = int(data[2])
    inv, p = init(n+5, mod)
    if n % 2 == 1:
        print(power(k, n, mod))
    else:
        special_nums = []
        for i in range(2, n+1, 2):
            if (i & n) == i:
                special_nums.append(i)
        dp = [[0]*(n+1) for _ in range(20)]
        total_ans = 0
        dp[0][n] = 1
        limit = min(17, k)
        for i in range(1, limit+1):
            partial_sum = 0
            for val in special_nums:
                if dp[i-1][val] == 0:
                    continue
                mask = val & (val - 1)
                step = mask ^ val
                v = step
                while v <= mask:
                    if (v & mask) == v:
                        val_dp = (dp[i-1][val] * p[val] % mod) * inv[v] % mod * inv[val - v] % mod
                        dp[i][v] = (dp[i][v] + val_dp) % mod
                    v += step
                partial_sum = (partial_sum + dp[i-1][val]) % mod
            total_ans = (total_ans + partial_sum * pow(inv[k - i], 1, mod)) % mod
        final_result = (power(k, n, mod) - p[k] * total_ans) % mod
        print(final_result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
